Sofwave Ultrasound Treatment-How to Maximize Your Results

Sofwave is a non-invasive next generation ultrasound treatment to lift, tighten, and tone the brow, face, neck and skin. It improves lines, wrinkles, and sagging skin without downtime.

PRE-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS

  1. Arrival and Preparation:
    • Arrive on time for your scheduled appointment. Avoid applying any skincare products, makeup, or sunscreen after your first cleansing of the day.
    • Ensure that you have eaten prior to your appointment to maintain comfort during the procedure.
    • Arrive jewelry-free and, if receiving a neck treatment, wear a V-neck top for easy access to the treatment area.
  2. Photos and Consent:
    • Photographs and consent documentation will be completed prior to treatment, if not already done.
  3. Pre-Treatment Cleansing and Numbing:
    • A team member will thoroughly cleanse the skin to remove any residual product or debris.
    • Topical numbing cream will be applied to the treatment area and will remain for approximately 30 minutes to enhance comfort during the procedure.
  4. Contraindications – Reasons to Avoid Sofwave:
    • Active cystic acne or open wounds in the treatment area
    • Metal implants within the treatment area
    • Recent dermal filler treatment in the treatment area (wait at least two weeks before and after Sofwave treatment)
    • Please notify our team if any of the above apply to you to determine if Sofwave is appropriate at this time.

POST-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS

  1. Expected Effects:
    • Mild redness and/or swelling may occur in the treated area and typically resolve within a few hours.
    • Warmth or tenderness in the treatment area may persist but should subside without intervention.
    • There should be no persistent pain after the procedure. Contact the office if discomfort persists.
  2. Skin Care:
    • You may resume your regular skincare routine immediately following the treatment.
    • Apply sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher to protect the treated area from UV exposure.
  3. Follow-Up:
    • Results develop gradually over time, with most patients noticing improvements as early as two weeks post-treatment. Full results typically appear within three months.
    • A follow-up appointment is recommended in 3-4 months for post-treatment photos and evaluation.
    • For optimal results, a series of one to two treatments is generally recommended, with maintenance sessions every 12 months.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding your Sofwave treatment, please do not hesitate to contact our office.
